biggest_catch: Gengo publishes customer pricing ($0.06-$0.12/word) but not translator reward rates - the per-word figures circulating online are customer prices, which cannot be treated as worker pay.
catches: No official translator reward rates: Gengo's official pages show customer pricing, not what translators earn per word.
Per-word figures like $0.03-$0.08/word come from third-party reviews, not Gengo's official terms.
Work is short-deadline micro-jobs; availability and language-pair demand vary.
Must pass Gengo's translation tests and be a native speaker of the target language to access work.

eligibility: 18+; native speaker of target language; pass Gengo's two-part translation tests; eligible residency per official terms.
maximize: If Gengo ever publishes official translator reward rates, maximize by passing the Pro qualification test to unlock higher-rate projects, specializing in high-demand language pairs where customer pricing (and likely rewards) run higher, and working the short-deadline queue fast since job availability is first-come.
